callable.name: assess_pair
callable.trusted_source_roots: Only process configuration; never read from participant, episode, policy, or operator-evidence JSON. Source content pins remain mandatory for every override.

cli.output: New operator-owned path only; existing paths are not overwritten.
cli.runtime_note: NumPy is invoked only by the original strict metric, not as scientific model execution; this component grants no native runtime qualification.

episode_joins.identity_sha256: Must equal actual canonical sites/splits identity hash.
episode_joins.invalid_episode_behavior: Compute valid strict metrics, then return explicit UNQUALIFIED with EPISODE_CONTRACT_INVALID or exact binding-mismatch reason.
episode_joins.one_call: Author reference versus one declared A or B candidate; a single call is not complete paired A/B execution.
episode_joins.scored_packet_sha256: Must equal actual legacy comparison input_sha256 for operator, author, candidate.

legacy.output: Complete original comparison report under legacy_comparison, with descriptive_paired_delta copied from paired_delta.
legacy.private_module_namespace: Created from the authenticated exact source bytes for the call; previous occupants are restored afterward.
legacy.strict_numeric_refusal: Legacy Refusal remains ValueError with original reason; nonfinite or incomplete prediction/target operands are not converted into favourable or UNQUALIFIED numeric scores.
legacy.undefined_metric: Preserve None if any required site Pearson is undefined; never drop a site.

policy_precommit.descriptor_bounds: Integer bytes in 1..1048576; lowercase SHA256 hex. These operational metadata bounds do not choose any scientific acceptance criterion.
policy_precommit.interpretation: Opaque claimed policy and commitment descriptors only; no artifact body, import path, callable, delta minimum, tolerance, bootstrap or uncertainty rule is consumed.

result.inference_scope: Conditional on one cell and the declared complete target/split/mask; sites and repeated stimulus rows are not independent biological replicates.

unbound_future_authority: A trusted scientific policy committed before candidate and test access, with a selected executable reproduction/improvement and uncertainty rule.
Enforcing physical transport and independently verifiable event chronology; candidate or caller JSON does not certify these.
Completed author reference and condition-specific candidate executions, programme/checkpoint/source selection, exact target/mask/split provenance.
